name: Cart total
description: The cart's item count and total in one line.
source:
Component(
  dsl: 1, id: "market/cart-total-line", name: "Cart total", kind: Kind.section,
  description: "The cart's item count and total in one line.",
  variants: [Variant(id: "default", label: "Default", build:
    Row(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center, children: [Expanded(child: Text(child: "${cart.count} items", color: Color.textMuted)), Text(child: formatMoney(cart.total_cents), size: FontSize.lg, weight: FontWeight.bold)])
  )], data: [Data(name: "cart", from: Client.cart(), fetch: "client", type: Cart)],
)
